method: Direct priorities --show assessments were empty for both exact semantic IDs. Route-check/lookup were used for successor trails; no new experiment or registry mutation was performed.

candidates.claim: SHED = STEHENLASSEN (leave standing), rather than older ABSETZEN or pure result ABGESETZT.

primary_claim_source.quote: The old ABSETZEN reading assumed sediment separation wherever the form occurred; the portable reading across all fifteen events is SHED = STEHENLASSEN, with SHED+DY (12), R+SHED+DY (1), and SHED+AL (2).

successor_decision.quote: Complete contexts retain SH = HALTEN and SHED = STEHENLASSEN; SHED closes 13/15, while two SHED+AL cases leave the item at a target. ABSETZEN would invent sediment separation everywhere; RUHEN loses the transitive instruction.
successor_decision.decision_scope: Restricts the portable core to an imperative released/standing state; local settling, resting, soaking or waiting remain context expansions, not universal meanings.

candidates.new_data_that_could_change_decision: An independently source-owned state or endpoint distinction showing that the same SHED construction requires sediment separation, passive rest, or active holding, especially in the two nonterminal SHED+AL cases.
candidates.invalid_test: More endpoint counts, repeating the same 15-context paraphrase, or assuming liquid sediment from the local picture would not discriminate the alternatives.

candidates.claim: P = EINFÜLLEN, a directed filling action in three owner-local receiving constructions.

primary_claim_source.quote: The three occurrences place material into owner-local receivers; HINEIN lacks a verb, EMPFAENGER produces noun piles, and plain FUELLEN omits the shared inward direction; compact value P = EINFÜLLEN.

successor_decision.quote: EINFÜLLEN fits the two Biological receivers but is too vessel-specific for the Herbal occurrence; invariant core P = EINBRINGEN, inward direction with receiver supplied by local owner, across 3 events.
successor_decision.decision_scope: Narrows the claim from vessel-specific filling to inward bringing into a receiver, work site, filter or application locus; K=ZUGEBEN and L=LEITEN remain separate.

candidates.new_data_that_could_change_decision: Independent evidence identifying the operation and receiver role in the f11r Herbal occurrence, plus a source-owned contrast separating P from K and L without relying on the owner picture to supply the conclusion.
candidates.invalid_test: Three fluent owner-local paraphrases, receiver pictures, or substitution coverage cannot establish a lexical translation; the three occurrences are a bounded construction, not global proof.

limits: These are historical source claims and successor restrictions, not confirmed meanings. No broad lexical refutation is inferred.
